title: Indescribable
lyrics: [Em]From the highest of heights to the [D/F#]depths of the[G] sea,
[Em]From the colors of fall to the [D/F#]fragrance of[G] spring,
[Am7]Every creature unique in the [C/G]song that it [F]sings,
[C2]You placed the stars in the sky and You know them by[Em] name.
[C]Awestruck we fall to our knees as we humbly pro[Em]claim
Who has told every lightning bolt where it should go?
Or seen heavenly storehouses laden with snow?
Who imagined the sun and gave source to its light?
Yet conceals it to bring us the coolness of night?
You placed the stars in the sky and You know them by name.
You've seen the depths of my heart and You love me the same.
